description: In the thymus, dendritic cells, some carrying self-proteins taken from medullary epithelial cells, present self-peptide on MHC class II to CD4 developing T cells and help turn some into regulatory T cells. Mouse experiments show they contribute alongside the epithelial cells; in human thymus tissue, dendritic cells conditioned by TSLP from Hassall's corpuscles induced regulatory T cells in culture.
